title: Speech
description: Read English words, phrases and examples locally. Install the FP32 speech resources once (about 327 MB).
saved: Speech settings saved. New readings will use these settings.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Use English plain text, up to 2,000 characters.
errors.NOT_INSTALLED: Install speech resources in Settings → Speech first.
errors.INSTALL_FAILED: Speech resources could not be installed. Try installing again.
errors.BUSY: Speech is busy. Try again shortly.
errors.RUNTIME_FAILED: The speech runtime failed. Try reading again.
errors.INVALID_AUDIO: The generated audio is invalid or exceeds the duration limit.
errors.INVALID_TIMELINE: The word timestamps could not be verified.
errors.TEXT_LIMIT: This text cannot be safely divided into speech segments.
errors.TOKEN_LIMIT: This speech segment exceeds the model token limit.
errors.NOT_OWNER: This window does not own that speech request.
errors.SETTINGS_FAILED: Speech settings could not be read or saved.
errors.CLOCK_FAILED: The audio output clock is unavailable. Accurate word highlighting requires a valid output clock.
